items.title: Definition of Perimeter
items.explanation: The perimeter of any closed plane figure is the total distance covered along its outer boundary. For a polygon, it is the sum of the lengths of all its sides.

items.title: Perimeter of a Rectangle
items.explanation: The perimeter of a rectangle is calculated as 2 × (length + breadth). This is because opposite sides are equal, so you add length twice and breadth twice.

items.title: Perimeter of a Square
items.explanation: Since all four sides of a square are equal, the perimeter is calculated as 4 × side length. It is quadruple the length of one side.
